cfg.command: command: list of strings (or optional groups ["--opt", "{param}"])
cfg.procs: procs: the engine's process names (argv[0] / argv[1])
cfg.params_keys: params: keys made of letters / digits
cfg.device_param: device_param: must be one of the params
cfg.profile_value: profile {name}: {key}={value} is not in the menu
cfg.engine_shared: models {models} share the engine {engine}: add "match_file": true to it in engines.json
err.model_running: This model is running: stop it first.
settings.bad_models_dir: Models folder: give an absolute path (or one starting with ~/).
settings.models_busy: A download is running: wait for it (or cancel it) before moving the models folder.
run.died: Stopped by itself (code {code}): see the logs.
run.port_busy: Port {port} is already used by another program.
run.no_vram_hint: ({models} uses it: stop it, or pick the CPU)
upd.local_changes: Local changes in the repository: update cancelled.
upd.pull_failed: git pull failed (diverged branch?): see the log.
upd.building: building {old} → {new}… (the running model is not touched)
upd.done: Built ({old} → {new}). Stop / restart the model to use it.
upd.build_failed: Build failed: back to {old}, previous binary kept. See the log.
hf.401: Repository not found, or private / gated (then run "hf auth login" in WSL).
fit.provided: Already installed: {engine} loads this model itself. Nothing to download.
fit.no_engine: {fmt} format: no engine in engines.json runs this format.
fit.wrong_kind: {kind} model: {engines} doesn't run this kind of model.
fit.not_installed: {fmt} format: {engine} is declared but not installed.
fit.min_cc: {quant} needs a GPU of generation {cc}+, yours is {gpu_cc}.
fit.disk: Not enough disk space: {size} for {free} free.
fit.gpu: Fits on the GPU: ~{need} needed, {usable} usable.{busy}
fit.busy: Whatever uses the VRAM must be stopped first.
fit.partial: Too big for the VRAM (~{need} for {usable}): part of it will run on CPU / RAM, much slower.
fit.no_ram: Too big: ~{need} needed, {usable} of VRAM + RAM.
fit.mmproj: Vision projector: optional, download it with the model for images.
dl.no_space: Not enough space: {size} to download, {free} free.
dl.running: A download of this repository is already running.
lib.used_by: Used by {models}: remove that model first (or change its file).
lib.downloading: Download in progress: cancel it first.
eng.min_cc: Needs a GPU of generation {cc}+, yours is {gpu_cc}.
eng.kept: Installed. "{id}" was already in engines.json: left as is.
eng.registered: Installed and added to engines.json: it is offered in the model form.
